title: Open-set-site presentation of a ringed-space cup square
statement: Fix a module universe $\mathcal U$ in which all open-set sites are small [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $X,X\prime,Y,Y\prime$ be ringed spaces, $f:X\to Y$, $f\prime:X\prime\to Y\prime$, $g:Y\prime\to Y$, and $g\prime:X\prime\to X$. Use their sheaf-of-module categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], tensor products [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], and K-flat complexes [def-pc-kflat-complex]. An open-site cup-square presentation consists of four corners, four edges and a ringed tensor square as in [def-weil-pbc-ringed-tensor-square-presentation], subject to the following specialization. The corner for $Z$ has site $\operatorname{Opens}(Z)$ with its open-cover topology, ring sheaf $\mathcal O_Z$, and a tensor bifunctor with its natural total-tensor identification on flat-term K-flat pairs. For an edge representing $v:Z\to W$, its set-sheaf inverse and direct images are the topological inverse and direct images of $v$; its inverse-image ring is $v^{-1}\mathcal O_W$ and its ring map is the adjoint structural map $v^{-1}\mathcal O_W\to\mathcal O_Z$. Its module pullback has, on objects and morphisms, exactly the inverse-image-then-extension-of-scalars formulas of [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-adjoint-general]. Its ordinary direct image is $v_*$ and its derived right adjoint is the K-injective $Rv_*$ of [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. Retain all the edge adjunctions, derived comparison maps, canonical tensor comparisons and the square insertion equation from the general presentation. This is only a definition of presentation data; neither cup compatibility nor tensor-square coherence is a field. The open-site specialization does not change the relative cup product of [def-sfb-ringed-site-module-cup-product].
